newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dubai government takes stake in Emaar Properties, raises its capital to one billion dirhams.
- Yemen's population growth falls to 3.5 percent in 1996 from 3.7 percent in 1995.
- Turkish interior minister to terminate services of Moslem employees in 80 districts.
- Libyan leader mediates between Egyptian and Sudanese presidents.
- Arab Bank group establishes an Islamic bank with a capital of $56.4 million in Jordan.
